name: pikku-addon-screens
description: Build a Pikku addon that ships a screen for Pikku Studio: package layout, `definePlugin` screens, message keys, scopes, calling the addon's functions with `usePikkuRPC`, `wireAddon({ ui: true })`, `pikku new addon --ui`, and the build errors you will meet. TRIGGER when: asked for an addon with a screen/page/nav entry, when editing a `definePlugin` call or `src/screens.ts`, or when a screen must call an addon function. DO NOT TRIGGER for addons with no screens (use pikku-addon), for the screens of a user's own app (use pikku-ui and pikku-react), or for message wording only (use pikku-i18n).

findings.excerpt: pikku all          # in the addon: PKU345/346/357/358/359 surface here
bunx --bun vite build                         # compiles the screen TSX; a lazily imported library shows as its own client chunk
bunx --bun pikku dev --port 4740 $(node scripts/pikku-config.mjs)     # backend boots, serves /rpc (verified)
cd apps/studio && VITE_API_PROXY=http://localhost:4740 bunx vite dev --port 4741 --strictPort   # UNCONFIRMED in a browser
